entry.title: Mrs Karen Brown v St John of God [2026] FWC 3894
entry.content:
Karen Brown lodged an unfair dismissal application under s 394 of the Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth) after her dismissal on 29 July 2026, but the application was lodged on 22 August 2026, outside the 21-day period. The Fair Work Commission considered whether to extend time, found no exceptional circumstances, and dismissed the application. The case is a straightforward extension-of-time decision.

Key holding: An unfair dismissal application lodged out of time can only proceed if the Commission is satisfied that exceptional circumstances exist, assessed by the s 394(3) factors.

The Commission can only extend time if it is satisfied that there are 'exceptional circumstances', taking into account the matters in ss 394(3)(a) to (f).

entry.title: Ms Genevieve Dwyer v The Australian Broadcasting Corporation [2026] FWC 2762
entry.content:
Genevieve Dwyer applied under s739 of the Fair Work Act to resolve a dispute with the ABC about the interpretation of cl 54.6.3 of the ABC Enterprise Agreement 2022-2025. She argued that being on approved personal leave without pay at the time of a redundancy notification brought her within cl 54.6.3 (which allows employees on annual leave, long service leave or leave without pay to complete that leave).

Fair Work Commission, 22 Jul 2026, [2026] FWC 2762
